meta.title: Once the award is final, every awarded vendor's bid is marked awarded
gaps: The awarded_rfq recipe states that the award was submitted for approval, not fully approved and final.
The available read-back fields do not expose individual bids, awarded vendors, or a bid's selected/unawarded status.
The available vocabulary cannot verify that a non-awarded vendor retains an active, unawarded bid.

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event the QA vendor bid on, closed, and awarded to that vendor (award submitted for approval).
steps: The buyer reads the pricing round.
As the buyer, read the pricing round and check that the read succeeds.
words.expected: The app accepts it. Read back afterwards: the read succeeds.
